newsitem.title: ITALY: Man and two sons gunned down in Naples home.
newsitem.headline: Man and two sons gunned down in Naples home.

text.p: A man and two of his sons were shot dead in their home on Tuesday by gunmen thought to belong to a branch of the Naples Mafia, the Camorra.
Police said the bodies were discovered by the man's wife, Lucia Cardone, when she returned to the house in the San Giovanni area of the city. They were riddled with around 40 bullet wounds.
The Italian government recently sent 500 troops and 200 police to Naples to quell in-fighting between rival Camorra clans which has claimed almost 100 lives this year.
